title: Windows 10 Got One More Year
youtube_title: Windows 10 Security Updates Extended to 2027: What to Do | Fix It Friday
next: Next Friday: another fix from your comments
description: Still using a Windows 10 computer? Microsoft has extended free security updates for home PCs until October 2027, but only if your computer is enrolled. Kip and Bub show how to check, how to enroll, how to see if Windows 11 is free for you, what the end of Office 2021 updates on October 13 means, and the scam pop-ups to ignore.

scenes.say: Still using a Windows 10 computer? Good news: Microsoft quietly gave home computers one more year of free security updates, until October 2027. But there's a catch.
It's Fix It Friday. Today: Windows 10 got one more year.
First, your computer won't suddenly stop working. It will still turn on, open your files, and get online.
Security updates are the fixes that patch holes criminals use to break in. Here's the catch: you only get them if your computer is enrolled in Extended Security Updates.
To check, open Settings, then Update and Security, then Windows Update. Look for Extended Security Updates. If you see Enroll now, click it.
It's free if you turn on Windows Backup to save your settings with a Microsoft account. You don't have to back up all your files.
While you're there, see if your computer can move to Windows 11 for free. If it can, back up your photos and documents first, then upgrade when you're ready.
If your computer can't run Windows 11, use this extra year to plan for a new one. A Windows 11 computer, a Mac, or a simple Chromebook will all keep getting updates. Plan, don't panic.
One more date: if you use Office 2021, like Word or Excel, its security updates ended on October 13th. The apps still work, and Microsoft also offers free online versions of Word and Excel.

And watch out. Scammers love news like this. A pop-up or phone call saying your Windows has expired and you must call a number right now is a scam. Microsoft will never call you out of the blue. If you're worried, look up Microsoft's support website yourself.

card.text: "Windows expired, call now" is a scam.

scenes.say: So: your computer keeps working, make sure it's enrolled, check if Windows 11 is free, back up first, and ignore scary pop-ups.
Got a tech problem you want fixed? Leave it in the comments, and it might be a future Fix It Friday. See you next Friday.
